_meta.note: Multi-leaderboard per-model token pricing for the new Price tab. Sources: OpenRouter API (primary, input+output $/1M for 163 models mapped to canonical ids via vendor-alias matcher), Artificial Analysis aa_pricing snapshot (input+output, add-only for models OpenRouter lacks), llm-stats (blended $/M, 12 frontier flagships, cross-check). Prices stored as scores on input/output/blended_price_per_mtok_lower_better (lower better). Each score _source names the leaderboard. Prefer OpenRouter (current) over AA (2026-04 snapshot) on overlap.
